== Description ==
The [[2026 Boston Winter Classic]] Top 8.

Identified from dest photographs, the labeled 2026 Worlds G7 thumbnail, and the talking-head still [[:File:AJ Hatoum Euros 2026 tournament report.jpg]]:

* Back row, left to right: [[Phil Aasen]], [[Joe Olson]], [[Joe Horbey]], [[Hayes Hunter]], [[Andrew Moss]] ([[:File:Andrew Moss Corran on the Horn 35.jpg|Corran on the Horn 35]]).
* Front row, left to right: [[Sam Tashima]], [[AJ Hatoum]] (round glasses, navy shirt), [[Greg Shaw]].
